issues.problem: The explanation claims the answer is not dp[n−1], but in these presets dp[n−1] equals the answer, so the example does not illustrate the pitfall.
issues.fix: Use a preset where the last element is not part of the LIS, or rephrase to say 'dp[n−1] may not be the answer' and add a concrete counterexample.

issues.problem: The traceback narration is repeated twice (frames 12 and 13) without advancing the trace, which is confusing.

issues.problem: The script skips the update narration for frame 12 (dp[4] = 3) and jumps from frame 11 to frame 13, so the student does not hear why dp[4] changed.

issues.problem: The hint says 'ví dụ [5, 4, 3, 2, 1] cho dp toàn 1' but the decreasing preset already shows this; the hint is correct but redundant.

issues.where: frames mixed index 47 / increasing index 22 / dups index 11 / decreasing index 12 / single index 2 (beat:best)
issues.problem: The sentence 'Đáp án là max(dp) = 4, ở vị trí 7, không phải dp[n − 1]' is self-contradictory in the mixed preset: the best position IS n−1 = 7, so the 'not dp[n−1]' clause is false there (it is only true for decreasing/single).
issues.fix: Make the clause conditional, e.g. 'Đáp án là max(dp) = 4 (ở đây trùng với dp[n−1] = 4, nhưng nói chung phải lấy max vì dãy tốt nhất có thể kết thúc sớm hơn).'

issues.problem: The narration 'Nối a[i] vào sau dãy kết thúc tại j có làm dp[i] = d tăng không?' is spoken at the frame BEFORE the comparison is evaluated, so the student cannot yet see whether dp[j]+1 > dp[i]; the answer only becomes visible in the next frame.
issues.fix: Ask the prediction at the frame where cand and up are shown (the frame after the comparison), or add cand/di to the pre-comparison frame's vars.
